provenance: Written by hand for judge calibration on 2026-11-01. Every person, employer and school is fictional; any resemblance is coincidental. Labels follow Matt's November 1 definition: a Critical Miss is any problem that would cost an interview on its own.
scoring: expected_critical is graded on blind calls (no key); null leaves a Critical Miss ungraded, as the gate does for the first one on a strong resume. expected_matches is graded on keyed calls; null leaves it ungraded. expected_pass is what the gate check should conclude: the keyed call on a bad resume (at least 2 of 3 labeled problems caught), the blind call on a strong one (no padding and no 'more than three').
